feeds.title: IFA Blog » Green Logistics
feeds.description: This blog by the International Forwarding Association (IFA) focuses on sustainable logistics and green supply chains. It covers topics such as eco-friendly packaging, green transportation, and reducing carbon footprint in logistics. IFA is a network of independent freight forwarders with a mission to promote sustainable and ethical business practices in the logistics industry.

feeds.title: The Greencarrier Blog
feeds.description: The Greencarrier Blog is the official blog of Greencarrier, a logistics and transport company that specializes in sustainable and eco-friendly solutions. Their blog covers a wide range of topics related to sustainable logistics, including industry news, company updates, and environmental initiatives.

feeds.title: Quicargo Blog
feeds.description: The ultimate blog for logistics, transport, and sustainability. Read study cases, research papers, and news articles, and watch interesting videos! Quicargo is a cargo platform for trucks providing Excellent service, reliable carriers, and great prices.

feeds.title: Logistics Matter » Sustainability

feeds.title: Green Fulfilment Blog
feeds.description: Green Fulfilment is a sustainable, owner operated, 3PL order fulfilment company and we help grow their business by providing services B2C & B2B fulfilment, bespoke order personalisation, kitting and returns. Explore the blog to learn how sustainable logistics is bringing a revolution to logistics industry.

feeds.title: Logistics Manager » Sustainability
feeds.description: Logistics Manager is the leading monthly magazine for managers in charge of the supply chain of the UK's largest industrial, retail and commercial organisations. On this website we publish daily news stories which include Sustainability.

feeds.title: MD Logistics » Sustainability
feeds.description: MD Logistics is a third-party logistics provider (3PL) that specializes in pharmaceutical, retail, and consumer goods industries. Their blog covers topics on sustainability, such as eco-friendly warehousing, sustainable packaging, and reducing waste in logistics. They aim to promote environmental sustainability in their operations and across their industry.
